name: bigslick
description: Big Slick: the open-source marketing distribution for Claude. 249 skills spanning strategy and positioning frameworks, SEO and content, paid channels, CRO, GTM and prospecting, pipeline and exec reporting, and an AI-visibility (GEO) system — with swappable per-company context packs. 245 skills are vendored from MIT/Apache-2.0 upstreams; 4 first-party infrastructure skills are MIT.
